blocks.name: The leverage line
blocks.plain: One act still moves more than any other, and a third overnight session (the Sensei session, 9/20) did not change it. BOLO 24 is finished work: the character sheet, the Season 1 beats, the gates table, the slice pipeline, S4-01 rendered, BORESIGHT 24 priced against it. What is left is a date. Name the launch month and four open calls stop being questions, because every one of them is measured from it. Chief's own order puts BOLO 64's four questions first in line; they are quick, and the month comes right behind them.

strand.last: One session landed, 9/20 19:42 to 06:12. It proved the launch sequence end to end, stood up BOLO 74 (Sensei, the second agent: KoboldCpp and SillyTavern beside JUDY on the one card), built BOLO 75 (the Stash deck), ruled SOP rules 11 and 12, and fixed JUDY's paste by launching her from Bash. One cache note sat on the rack. None of it touched the main effort.
strand.plan: Stand the Command up with one word and open Sensei in the same breath, then bring the board to Chief without the main line reading a file.
strand.you: You said 'spin up the launch sequence' and 'Naked, I say again Naked' at 06:17. Seven stations came up GO: the DARKROOM started fresh, JUDY restarted from Bash, Stash and the knobs were already live, the wire probed seven of seven, both boards opened. Sensei answered on both ports in twelve seconds. Three specialists ran; the reviewer caught two unregistered glossary keys and BOLO 64 unplaced, both fixed by hand, and this block was written off the digest.
strand.next: Two rulings, in Chief's order: the four questions on BOLO 64 first, then the launch month for BOLO 24, now sixteen days idle. Six older rows in Block V still wait, one since March. BOLO 71 and 72 wait on 'go 71' and 'confirm the comp'.

blocks.why: The slice is finished work parked on an unanswered date, and 9/20 proved it again: a second agent, a deck, two SOP rules and a launch fix landed in one ten-hour session, and the main effort did not move. Build capacity is not the constraint; rulings are. Two BOLOs closed this pass (74, 75) against three opened since the last board, and seven rows in Block V are unchanged, one since March. BOLO 64's four questions sit above it by Chief's word and take minutes. The month is the ruling that releases work already sitting done, and every one of 24's four remaining calls is measured from it.
